Text: I've been testing Bot Mode in the Hermes Desktop App a bit today, so I made a quick video showing the key features and how it differs from a normal Hermes session:

- Side bar shows a list of bots (agent profiles) you can talk to
- Agent Inbox allows bots to communicate directly with one another
- Create Agent to make a new bot with a custom PFP, description, and configuration
- Cron jobs bar on the right to create crons for specific bots

Still in testing for the next day, so let's test it out and see how it can be improved!
